_comment: FICTIONAL golden expectations for the pricing engine, derived INDEPENDENTLY of src/engine by hand/script from docs-m2-design.md and the fixture files in this folder (fixture-rate-card.csv, fixture-zone-chart.csv, fixture-service-terms.json, fixture-rules.json, fixture-zip-lists.json, fixture-overrides.json). Two independent derivations (one scripted, one manual) were reconciled on 2026-10-15; they agreed on every value. Amounts are decimal strings rounded HALF_UP to 2 dp per line; totals are sums of rounded lines. Line order is per package (base, minimum adjustment, per-package surcharges), then shipment-level lines, then fuel lines; tests should compare lines order-insensitively. None of these numbers are real carrier rates. One deliberate post-reconciliation change: in ground_no_dimensions_estimated the fuel line is classed estimated (design rule 1.9: a percentage of an estimated base is an estimate).
